title: Design System: Earth, From a Million Miles

display.purpose: The page title only. At desktop width it uses clamp(3rem, 4.5vw, 4.6rem).

headline.purpose: The chosen date, with lining numerals.

title.purpose: The event name at the top of the event panel; 18px beside a mark in the fallback view.

body.purpose: Introduction, caption and summary, held to 36ch to 46ch.

body-small.purpose: Panel text, source links, the line under the globe. List rows use 15px, the credit line 12px.

label.purpose: Uppercase text on pills, chips and toggles. The events heading uses 14px with 0.07em tracking.

label-small.purpose: Uppercase terms above values in the event panel and readouts; the category line under the panel title.

figure.purpose: Frame number and time under each photograph, in tabular numerals.

shadows.name: panel-drop
shadows.purpose: Under the event panel, to separate it from the globe it floats over.

shadows.name: globe-halo
shadows.purpose: A very faint cool glow around the globe, inset 5% from its edge.

shadows.name: second-ring
shadows.purpose: A 1px ring drawn 5px outside the border of the two main actions, Play and Random day.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus on every control. The globe itself uses an offset of -6px.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The one easing curve for larger movements: globe arrival, photograph dissolve, panel entry, selection circle.

motion.name: control
motion.purpose: Border, background and colour changes on pills, circles, chips and photographs.

motion.name: row
motion.purpose: Background change on event list rows and the panel close button.

motion.name: circle-draw
motion.value: 0.5s (520ms cubic ease-out on the globe canvas)
motion.purpose: The selection circle drawing clockwise from the top after the globe finishes turning.

motion.name: photo-dissolve
motion.purpose: The reconstruction dissolving into the real photograph.

motion.name: globe-arrival
motion.purpose: The globe coming up out of the dark as its photographs load.

motion.name: frame-step
motion.purpose: Cross-fade between photographs in the fallback view.

components.name: Pill Button
components.description: The default control: a thin outlined pill. Used for previous day, next day and the date field.
components.css: .ds-pill-wrap { display: flex; gap: 8px; padding: 12px; background: #000; } .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.24); border-radius: 999px; background: none; color: #fff; cursor: pointer; font-family: 'Geist Variable', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; transition: border-color 0.2s, background 0.2s, color 0.2s; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-pill:hover { border-color: #fff; } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-pill:disabled { opacity: 0.35; cursor: default; } .ds-pill-icon { width: 1.25em; height: 1.25em; flex: none; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

components.name: Main Action Pill (Random day)
components.description: The same pill with a second, fainter ring 5px outside its border. Reserved for the two main actions.

components.name: Play Button
components.description: The one accent-filled control: a 44px Atmosphere Blue circle with a black icon and the second ring.

components.description: An outlined pill that inverts to white fill and black text when pressed.

components.name: Category Chip
components.description: Event filter: a 36px outlined pill with the category dot, name and a dim count. Off state dims and strikes through.

components.description: 40px outlined circles with a black fill, stacked in the lower right corner of the globe.

components.description: Plain rows on the black ground with a category dot. The selected row gets a faint wash and reveals its source link; far-side events are dim.

components.description: The day's photographs as small round planets under a hairline. The current one is full strength with a thin white circle around it. Grey discs stand in for the photographs here.

narrative.overview:
The screen is a black field holding one photographic object, the globe, with white type and a few thin outlines set around it. Everything that is not the planet is drawn in white at one of three strengths, in one typeface at one weight. There is no chrome: no cards behind the lists, no header bar, no dividers except one hairline above the day's photographs. The system is calm, exact and quiet, so that the photograph reads as the only rich thing on the page.

Colour is rationed. The planet carries the colour. Five data colours mark natural events on it, and the same five appear as small dots beside the matching filter chips and list rows. One pale atmosphere blue fills the Play button. Hierarchy comes from size and from the three ink steps, never from weight: the title is large and tight, body text is compact, and controls and list headings are small uppercase labels with open tracking.

Controls are outlines, not objects: thin pills and circles that brighten their border on hover. Exactly one thing on the page is a solid surface, the panel that opens beside a chosen event. The system explicitly rejects serif and handwritten type, texture and glass blur, a dashboard arrangement of boxed panels, and any sci-fi cockpit decoration (neon, HUD frames, mission-control ornament).
keyCharacteristics: Pure black ground with a very faint grey lift behind the globe.
One grotesque, Geist, at regular weight (400) for every piece of text.
White ink in three steps; emphasis is a brighter step, not a bolder weight.
Thin outlined pills and circles for controls; one filled accent button.
Colour only where it is data: the photograph, the event marks, and Play.
Everything on one screen at desktop width; one column in a deliberate order on a phone.

rules.name: The Colour Is Data Rule
rules.body: Saturated colour appears only on the photograph and on event marks and their matching dots. The five event colours are never used for text, borders, backgrounds or decoration.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Atmosphere Blue belongs to Play. No second element is filled with it.

rules.name: The Three Steps Rule
rules.body: Text is Ink, Soft or Dim. To emphasise a phrase inside running text, raise it one step (Soft to Ink); do not change its weight.

rules.name: The One Weight Rule
rules.body: Every piece of text is weight 400. Bold and strong elements are reset to 400. Nothing on the page is bold, medium or light.

rules.name: The Two Tracks Rule
rules.body: Sentence-case text is tracked negative (-0.01em to -0.025em, tighter as it gets larger). Uppercase labels are tracked positive (0.06em). There is no text between the two: no uppercase heading at display size, no sentence-case label with open tracking.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Any number that changes while the visitor watches (coordinates, times, distances, the date field) uses tabular numerals so the text does not shift.

rules.name: The One Solid Object Rule
rules.body: The event panel is the only element with a filled background and a drop shadow. Lists, filters, the title block and the photographs sit directly on the black ground with nothing behind them.

dos: Do set every piece of text in Geist at weight 400, and create emphasis by moving up an ink step (Dim, Soft, Ink).
Do build controls as 1px outlined pills (999px radius, 40px tall) or circles that turn their border white on hover.
Do keep saturated colour for the photograph, the five event colours and the Play button.
Do give uppercase labels 0.06em tracking and keep them small (11px to 14px); give sentence-case text negative tracking.
Do place lists, filters and text directly on the black ground, separated by space.
Do use tabular numerals for coordinates, times, distances and dates.
Do keep every feature on the screen at every width; make a feature quieter rather than removing it.
donts: Don't use a serif, a handwritten face or a second typeface of any kind.
Don't use bold, medium or light weights.
Don't add texture, grain, glass blur or a gradient fill on type or controls. The only gradients are the faint lift behind the globe and edge fades on masks.
Don't put a filled panel, card or border box behind the title block, the filters, the event list or the photographs. The event panel is the only solid surface.
Don't arrange the page as a dashboard of boxed widgets, and don't add sci-fi cockpit decoration: neon, glowing outlines, HUD frames or mission-control ornament.
Don't use an event colour or Atmosphere Blue for text, borders or decoration.
Don't stack an uppercase label above a larger heading as a kicker. Labels belong to controls, chips, list headings and the terms in the event panel.
Don't add drop shadows to controls, rows or text blocks. The panel drop and the globe halo are the only two.
